apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 195 keeps restored sessions on the return banner until tapped, prevents overlapping reconnects and refreshes the retained allocation directly instead of discarding it when a zone list is empty. Failed returns remain retryable with visible error text. Retains selected video/HUD settings, Metal 4, vibration, controller layouts, immersive mode and Sessions. 234 simulator tests passed, one hardware-only skip; unsigned Release archive verified. Physical repeat-return and lag/pixelation verification pending. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
